data.narrative: The student crafted an exemplary blameless postmortem for a critical e-commerce order-dropping outage. They rigorously separated human triggers from systemic root causes, audited a blame-heavy anti-pattern draft with deep analytical precision, and produced verifiable action items with explicit role owners and definitions of done.

dimension_scores.observation: Audited the blame-heavy peer postmortem, catching 17 distinct instances of personal blame, pointing out that 0 of 5 action items were systemic, and demonstrating how blaming individuals destroys incident visibility.
dimension_scores.evidence: Identified that blaming responders incentivizes concealment of near-misses and leaves the underlying swallowed exception vulnerability untouched.

dimension_scores.observation: Produced a clear executive summary and structured chronological timeline highlighting exact time-to-detect and time-to-mitigate metrics.
dimension_scores.evidence: postmortem.md clearly captures TTD (55m), TTM (39m), $186k revenue impact, and resolution timeline in a structured table.

dimension_scores.observation: Maintained an objective, blameless tone throughout, framing all failures around process, tooling, and architectural guardrails rather than individual engineers.
dimension_scores.evidence: Scanned document with zero personal names; replaced individual blame with systemic descriptions (e.g. 'on-call responder', 'Platform Engineering rotation').

dimension_scores.observation: Followed industry-standard postmortem structure: Executive Summary -> Chronological Timeline -> Systemic Root Causes -> Contributing Factors -> Action Items -> Lessons Learned.
dimension_scores.evidence: Organized into six distinct sections, distinguishing root causes (swallowed exception) from contributing factors (untested rollback, alert latency).

dimension_scores.observation: Constructed high-impact action items with role ownership, realistic deadlines, and unambiguous definitions of done.
dimension_scores.evidence: All 5 action items specify system changes: exception refactoring, Datadog zero-order monitor, automated weekly canary rollback CI testing, and Zod config validation.

strengths: Demonstrated systems-first thinking by rejecting 'be more careful' human behavioral traps in favor of mechanical automation and CI checks.
Distinguished between triggering actions and systemic root causes, recognizing that error masking was the true failure mechanism.
data.recommendation: In future incident reviews, continue integrating semantic business invariants alongside technical vitals across all alerting tiers.

public_evidence.student_action: Authored comprehensive blameless postmortem analyzing a 2-hour silent order loss incident, formulating 5 concrete engineering remediations.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Complete postmortem document with executive summary, timeline, systemic root causes, contributing factors, and action items table.
public_evidence.proof: postmortem.md includes TTD/TTM analysis, swallowed exception root cause, untested rollback contributing factor, and automated CI/monitoring action items.
public_evidence.ability: Conducts blameless incident investigations that convert catastrophic operational outages into permanent systemic resilience.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows mature production engineering leadership: understands that reliability is an organizational feedback loop dependent on psychological safety and mechanical verification.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Replaced individual fault-finding with systemic inquiry into why tooling allowed failure.

concepts_demonstrated.concept: Systemic action items vs behavioral wishes
concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Formulated automated CI checks and canary monitors instead of 'remind team to be careful'.
Separated the primary error-suppression failure from secondary detection and rollback delays.

teaching_approaches.detail: Analyzed Etsy 2012 database deletion case study to explain incident reporting incentives.

learning_style_signals: Excels when analyzing the contrast between punitive and systems-oriented postmortem artifacts.
